scope: Isolated project, real dashboard/MCP/acceptance checks and Chromium; no models, provider credentials or production adoption.
source_reuse: All dashboard code and tests are byte-identical between implementation_commit and source_commit; follow-up changes test capture geometry and main's single-character starts_with.

gif.processing: Join real captures on a common white padded canvas; no UI mockup or annotation.

performance_scope: Warm component rendering including DOM/layout, 5 samples after warmup, 40 and 200 fixture tasks, no network or checks; platform values in manifests. Single first-task timings are observations, not a performance improvement claim.
caveats: Verification is a timestamped read, not an automatic background check.
Human acceptance and production adoption remain separate.
Hosted CI must be checked on the latest PR head.
